'''Jackar Bowmani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] who was employed to work in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as a munitions expert and was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="SabotageGuide" /> Jackar Bowmani was a [[Technician/Legends|maintenance worker]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. At some point, Bowmani married to [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]].<ref name="Sabotage" /> Bowmani was originally working as a man in charge of maintenance in the temple platform. According to Bowmani's wife, it was his dream to work for the Jedi and he had passed all of the entry tests with "flying colors".<ref name="SabotageGuide" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DS1" /> Bowmani was fed [[Nano-droid/Legends|Nano-droids]] by his wife, and was used to [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|blow up]] the Temple's hangar,<ref name="Sabotage" /> killing six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> clones, and other hangar workers in the process and destroying all but his hand. At first, it was assumed that Bowmani handled the action of the attack willingly until [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went to his home and arrested Turmond after she attempted to flee and admitted to putting the nanobots in the food to turn Bowmani into a walking bomb. Turmond, prior to her death, later stated that she had been requested to do so by a disgruntled member of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Sabotage" />

==Behind the scenes==
While the upper limbs of an Abyssin normally end in two claws and an opposable thumb,<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the hand of Bowmani shown in "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]" was [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like in appearance, with four fingers and no claws.<ref name="Sabotage" />
